original_ai_output.title_zh: 南苏丹将模拟疑似病毒病例以测试应急响应
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 南苏丹卫生部宣布，将于10月19日至23日在朱巴、耶伊和扬比奥开展全面模拟演练，模拟发现一例疑似本迪布焦埃博拉病毒病病例，以测试监测、感染防控、患者转运和隔离等应急响应流程。卫生官员强调，此次演练属防范性活动，不应被解读为疫情暴发声明。尼穆莱边境口岸因预算限制未纳入首阶段演练，将考虑在第二阶段进行。

key_facts.fact: 南苏丹卫生当局将在朱巴、耶伊和扬比奥开展全面模拟演练，测试对潜在本迪布焦埃博拉病毒病病例的防范与响应系统
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: South Sudan’s health authorities will conduct a full-scale simulation exercise to test the country’s preparedness and response systems for a potential Bundibugyo Ebola Virus disease (BVD) case in Juba, Yei and Yambio

key_facts.fact: 演练定于10月19日至23日举行，模拟在朱巴国际机场发现疑似病例并报告至应急行动中心
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The exercise, scheduled to run from 19 to 23 October, will simulate the detection of a suspected case and test how health authorities coordinate emergency response activities

key_facts.fact: 卫生部长强调该演练属防范性活动，不应被解读为疫情暴发声明
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The exercise is a preparedness activity and should not be interpreted as a declaration of an outbreak.

key_facts.fact: 尼穆莱边境口岸因预算限制未纳入首阶段演练，将考虑在第二阶段进行
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Nimule had not been excluded permanently but would be considered in a second phase because of budget constraints.

key_facts.fact: 据估计约有2000至3000人从刚果（金）经伊巴县纳班加地区返回南苏丹，人数仍在增加，卫生团队正进行筛查和监测
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the NPHI representative estimated that between 2,000 and 3,000 people had crossed back into the country around the Nabanga area of Ibba County, adding that the number was increasing
